key_updates: DTCC launched DTS on 2026-10-28 using Canton and DTCC private Besu; future network additions are not named.
DTCC reports $114T assets under custody, 20 participant agreements and more than 150 firms in its working group.
Circle and BitGo were named participants in the 2026-07-15 DTCC production event; BitGo is also an Oct28 launch collaborator.
Neither XRP nor Ripple is named in the July15 or Oct28 DTCC release; this is disconfirming evidence for claims that XRP is already part of DTS.
Q-Eternal reports XRPL RLUSD obligations down 3.855M and Ethereum RLUSD supply up 27.446M from Oct28 to Oct29; this is a chain-supply mix observation, not proof of a bridge transfer.
Q-Eternal reports limited use of the measured permissioned domains and no XRP-intermediated settlement in the measured EUROP/XRP pool; independent reproduction remains pending.
